    Boundary data needed to turn a coefficient-head tensor into the next End H-relative tail.

    References:

    • BocaFiniteNaimarkTwoSided.lean:110 asks for this relStep.
    • BocaFiniteNaimarkRecursion.lean:79 gives the coefficient head bocaFiniteNaimarkCorr : CorrBimod (Fin m -> Complex) H.
    • CorrTensorTailEnd.lean:23-28 names the required separate tail action.
    • CorrTensorTailEnd.lean:105-108 records why tailEnd = M.leftEnd is not valid.
    • toTailData : CorrTensorTailEndData M
    • tailEnd : End H →⋆ₐ[ℂ] End (CorrTensor E M)
    • tailEnd_incl (a : End H) (u0 : CorrTensor0 E M) : (self.tailEnd a) ((corrTensorIncl E M) u0) = (corrTensorIncl E M) ((corrTensorTailEnd0 E M self.toTailData a) u0)
